info.title: Daily Ops Last Mile Dashboard
info.description: Live nationwide operations dashboard for Ninja Van's last-mile fleet (143 stations across Southern, Northern, Klang Valley, East Coast, and East Malaysia). Pulls parcel-level and route-level data hourly from Redash (queries 78, 1297, 653, 512) and serves in-hub/zero-attempt/on-hold/pending-ATS/aging/prior-tag/COD% counts plus Missing Hub-vs-Ship-in and Total Routed/Attendance, by station/zone/region, scoped to the signed-in user's role. Every count has a click-to-see-tracking-numbers drill-down except route-level totals and percentages.

get.summary: Liveness check used by the platform to confirm the backend container is up.
Return the signed-in user's identity and role/scope, derived from the SSO-injected X-Forwarded-Email header.

200.description: Current user identity (unauthenticated or unprovisioned users get null/false fields)

get.summary: Return the latest station metrics snapshot, filtered to the caller's role scope, with zone and region rollups.

200.description: Latest snapshot, scoped to the caller

get.summary: List all active/virtual stations nationwide (hub code, name, zone, region) from the station reference data.
List all regions and the zones within each, for building region/zone pickers in the UI.
List all users provisioned for the dashboard, with their role and scope. Admin only.

post.summary: Provision a new user with a role and access scope (all / region / zone / station). Admin only.

409.description: That email is already set up

patch.summary: Update an existing user's role, scope, or display name. Admin only.

delete.summary: Remove a user's access to the dashboard. Admin only; an admin cannot remove their own access.

get.summary: Return the tracking numbers behind one station's metric count, for the UI's click-a-number drill-down. Served from an in-memory cache built by the last refresh.

schema.description: One of the drilldown-eligible metric keys (all StationRow metrics except total_fresh)

403.description: That station isn't in the caller's scope

422.description: metric is not a drilldown-eligible key

get.summary: Return the latest Shipment Details snapshot (Total Fresh/Shipment, Fresh Unscan, Latlong, Fresh Attempt %, LH trip timings), scoped to the caller.

200.description: Latest snapshot, scoped to the caller

get.summary: Return the tracking numbers behind one station's Fresh Unscan or Latlong count.

403.description: That station isn't in the caller's scope

422.description: metric is not fresh_unscan or latlong

get.summary: Return the latest Routed View snapshot (Total Routed/Attendance/OVFD/Success/COD%/Success Rate/Completion Rate) at station/zone/region level, plus a driver-level breakdown, scoped to the caller.

200.description: Latest snapshot, scoped to the caller

post.summary: Trigger an immediate Redash pull and metrics recompute, instead of waiting for the hourly scheduler. Admin only.

200.description: Result of the refresh that just ran

get.summary: Return the status of the most recent refresh (scheduled or manual). Admin only.

200.description: Most recent refresh-log entry, or null if none have run yet

get.summary: Return the latest Shipper Watch snapshot (Amway/Watson/Orca hypercare, Zalora NXD, Restock NXD), scoped to the caller.

200.description: Latest snapshot, scoped to the caller

get.summary: Return the tracking numbers behind one station's Shipper Watch metric count.

schema.description: amway_zero_attempt | amway_aging | watson_zero_attempt | watson_aging | orca_ovfd | orca_other | zalora_zero_attempt | zalora_ovfd | zalora_other

403.description: That station isn't in the caller's scope

200.description: Latest snapshot for that type, scoped to the caller

422.description: type is not one of the 5 aging sub-views

get.summary: Return the latest Old Route snapshot -- tracking numbers still stuck on their original Route ID/date (query 1451) -- at region/zone/station/driver level, scoped to the caller.

200.description: Latest snapshot, scoped to the caller

MetricFields.description: All fields are grouped by last_scan_hub_name (where a parcel physically is right now) unless noted otherwise -- see backend/aggregate.py for the full formulas.

total_in_hub.description: last_scan_hub_name == dest_hub, excludes On Hold/On Vehicle for Delivery

zero_attempt.description: Subset of total_in_hub with 0 delivery attempts

pending_ats_zero_attempt.description: last_scan_hub_name != dest_hub, 0 delivery attempts -- not yet added to a shipment to its real destination

pending_ats_attempted.description: Same as pending_ats_zero_attempt but with 1+ delivery attempts already made

missing_open.description: Open missing-parcel tickets, total (grouped by dest_hub_name)

missing_hub.description: Subset of missing_open classified as a station-side issue

missing_ship_in.description: Subset of missing_open classified as an in-transit issue

total_fresh.description: Total orders received today per hub (query 653, grouped by dest_hub_name)

age_gt3.description: total_in_hub aged >3 days, excludes On Hold/On Vehicle for Delivery

reschedule.description: total_in_hub with 1+ delivery attempts already made

prior_d0.description: total_in_hub, status Arrived at Sorting Hub, PRIOR tag, 0 attempts

prior_gt_d0.description: total_in_hub, status Arrived at Sorting Hub, PRIOR tag, aged >0 days

unsweep_document.description: query 58 (Unsweep), grouped by last_scan_hub_name, TN matches the document pattern (-DO/-MYPSO/MYRDO*/contains GRN)

unsweep_parcel.description: query 58 (Unsweep), grouped by last_scan_hub_name, everything not matching the document pattern

total_routed.description: From query 512, matched by full station name

attendance.description: Unique drivers with a route today, from query 512, excluding names containing OPS

cod_pct_routed.description: % of total_routed that is COD, from query 512

key.description: The zone or region name this row rolls up

previous_captured_at.description: Timestamp of the second-most-recent snapshot, for trend deltas

last_seen_at.description: Last time this user's /api/me was called (i.e. last opened the dashboard)

scope_value.description: Region name, zone name, or station name, matching scope_type

as_of.description: When the in-memory cache backing this was built (the last refresh); null if no refresh has run since restart

total_shipment.description: Sum of query 1500's total_shipments per hub

latlong.description: query 1239 rows where shp_dest_hub_name != latest_dest_hub_name and tag doesn't contain RTS

fresh_attempt_count.description: query 1239 rows where first_attempt_date is set

process_time_minutes.description: Average minute-of-day (0-1439) 1st_sweep_at_WM_station finished, today only (Malaysia time); null if no sweeps recorded today

lh_trips.description: Up to 2 line-haul trips, sorted by arrival time

zero_attempt.description: Merged in from the latest Station Health snapshot

attendance.description: Unique non-OPS drivers with a route today

attendance_hd.description: Subset of attendance: Hybrid Driver (full-time staff)

attendance_hr.description: Subset of attendance: Hybrid Rider (full-time staff)

attendance_rescue.description: Subset of attendance whose name-prefix home station differs from the station they're currently routing at

region.description: The zone's parent region (for zone-level rows) or the region itself (for region-level rows)

driver_type.description: Hybrid Driver | Hybrid Rider | Independent Driver | Independent Rider | OPS | Unknown -- only HD/HR/ID/IR count toward Attendance, everything else (OPS, Unknown) still appears here and in every other total

home_station.description: From the station-abbreviation prefix of the driver's name

station_name.description: Same as current_station -- where this driver is routing today (may differ from home_station for a rescue driver)

drivers.description: Not persisted -- rebuilt in memory on every refresh, empty after a restart until the next refresh runs

amway_zero_attempt.description: query 78, Amway shipper, status=Arrived at Sorting Hub and delivery_attempts=0

orca_ovfd.description: query 78, TN contains ORCA (unconfirmed pattern), status=On Vehicle for Delivery

zalora_ovfd.description: Zalora NXD, dest_hub_name=last_sweep_hub_name, status=On Vehicle for Delivery

zalora_other.description: Zalora NXD, dest_hub_name=last_sweep_hub_name, any other status

restock_pieces.description: Restock NXD, summed piece_count per distinct bundle

restock_potential_breach.description: Restock NXD bundles whose days_group contains Potential

restock_breach.description: Restock NXD bundles whose days_group contains Breach (not Potential)

tn_rows.description: Full TN-level detail for this type, scoped to the caller
